messages.content: So basically anything I post online is automatically copyrighted to the platform, right?

Not automatically to the platform, no - honestly you generally retain copyright of your own content by default. Platforms usually get a license to host and display it, which is different from owning it outright. Worth actually reading the terms of service though, since license scope varies a lot.
